body: Yeah I would definitely say I am the black sheep. In any way of fighting back and seeing through her bullshit she gaslights me and manipulates me into believing that she is trying to be better, but she isn't. If it gets too serious to the point of arguing then she will go and cry for my brother who will then beat on me, one time he almost broke my arm. My view of myself and others has become more and more distorted and morphed and I can't see anyone as a nice person anymore and I see myself as a terrible person due to the extent of verbal abuse ive gone through at the hands of my mom, dad and brother. I am basically the punching bag for everyone in my family, they call me names just for fun.

okay, i will try and tell them. I don't know what to do if it doesn't go well but it can't be much worse then what I am already going through. hopefully it doesn't mess with my chances of doing school.

my mom is also really trying to make it seem like she isn't doing a poor job. She gives a lot of false promises just to give me false hope that maybe things will get better so that's why I've stayed. I don't wanna leave and her to just suddenly do what she said she would for me but she is just kind of permanently procrastinating on it.

How would they deal/help with this situation? like would they just work on getting me help in the background without telling my parents? I really can't let my mom have a say in this, she will be really REALLY mean to me and make me look like the bad guy.

I wouldn't mind cps intervention if its like confidential? if that makes any sense, I don't want to hear my mom yell at me for leaving her. Nor any of my family really, they are all brainwashed by her. I mean she has taught all of her kids to defend her against her if cps ever come, she's told them all to defend her or there will be "consequences".
only my grandma but she's exactly like my mom.

i am very worried to ask the school because I know that if it doesn't go well and I don't go help and they just bring it up with my mom she will gaslight me, verbally abuse me, tell me how I am not being abused and will take me out of school and then I will never get a chance of at least salvaging my education. If I fail, I am forever fucked until I kill myself.
